id: 03_EquiTips IC Biomedical Lab Dewars & Liquid Nitrogen Storage Explained
title: 实验室杜瓦瓶与液氮储存解析
source_doc: course/Industrial Gas & Cryogenic Equipment/03_EquiTips IC Biomedical Lab Dewars & Liquid Nitrogen Storage Explained.md
author_source: project/Industrial Gas & Cryogenic Equipment/03_EquiTips IC Biomedical Lab Dewars & Liquid Nitrogen Storage Explained/src.py

points.K1: 实验室液氮杜瓦罐用于储存和转运液氮，配套的液体取出器用于安全取出液氮
points.K2: 液氮罐有从小到大的多种容量规格，应按用量选择
points.K3: 取液器装在储罐上，出液嘴带相分离器，使液氮平稳流出、减少飞溅
points.K4: 充装时尽量少拆装取液器：不拆整个取液器、经接口接软管充装，更快、更安全，也减少部件磨损
points.K5: 储罐由专门工厂制造、经表面处理（原片以喷涂镜头和“美国制造”表现产地）
points.K6: 液氮罐和配件应从正规渠道采购

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在展台旁，桌上一排大小不同的银色液氮罐，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at an exhibition table lined with silver liquid nitrogen dewars of different sizes and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到设备小课堂，今天看液氮罐。
overlay: 实验室杜瓦瓶与液氮储存解析

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 小研走过来，和欣欣握手寒暄
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over and shakes hands with the panda mascot in a friendly greeting.
shots.narration: 嘉宾小研，是液氮罐厂家的销售代表。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰站在展台前，看着一排银色罐子发呆
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands in front of the exhibition table, staring at the row of silver dewars with a puzzled look.
shots.narration: 阿杰的实验室要买液氮罐，不知道怎么挑。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 欣欣招手让阿杰一起听
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves the young male student over to listen in.
shots.narration: 一起来听听厂家怎么介绍。

shots.section_title: 实验室液氮杜瓦罐用于储存和转运液氮，配套的液体取出器用于安全取出液氮
shots.scene: 小研指着桌上的银色液氮罐
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points to the silver dewars on the table.
shots.narration: 小研说，他们专做液氮杜瓦罐，
overlay: 液氮杜瓦罐与液体取出器

shots.section_title: 实验室液氮杜瓦罐用于储存和转运液氮，配套的液体取出器用于安全取出液氮
shots.scene: 一个带压力表、阀门和长取液管的取液器图示
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a liquid withdrawal device with a blank pressure gauge, a small valve and a long dip tube. No people.
shots.narration: 还有配套的液体取出器。

shots.section_title: 实验室液氮杜瓦罐用于储存和转运液氮，配套的液体取出器用于安全取出液氮
shots.scene: 液氮罐从库房被推到实验室的箭头示意
shots.prompt_en: An arrow diagram of a dewar being wheeled from a storage room to a laboratory bench. No people.
shots.narration: 罐子用来储存和转运液氮。

shots.section_title: 实验室液氮杜瓦罐用于储存和转运液氮，配套的液体取出器用于安全取出液氮
shots.scene: 取液器装在罐口，液氮经管子流出的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a withdrawal device mounted on a dewar neck with liquid nitrogen flowing out through a tube. No people.
shots.narration: 取液器借助罐内压力，把液氮取出来。

shots.section_title: 液氮罐有从小到大的多种容量规格，应按用量选择
shots.scene: 桌上的液氮罐从小到大依次排开
shots.prompt_en: Silver dewars lined up on the table from the smallest to the largest. No people.
shots.narration: 桌上这一排，是从小到大的系列。

shots.section_title: 液氮罐有从小到大的多种容量规格，应按用量选择
shots.scene: 欣欣手捧一套取液器，小研指向其中一只大罐
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a liquid withdrawal device while the female graduate student points to one of the larger dewars.
shots.narration: 这只三十五升的罐上，就装着取液器。

shots.section_title: 液氮罐有从小到大的多种容量规格，应按用量选择
shots.scene: 小罐、中罐、大罐三个图标旁各有一个用量刻度
shots.prompt_en: Three dewar icons small, medium and large, each beside a blank usage gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 用多少液氮，就挑多大的罐。

shots.section_title: 取液器装在储罐上，出液嘴带相分离器，使液氮平稳流出、减少飞溅
shots.scene: 小研走到装有取液器的罐旁，指着出液嘴
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks to the dewar fitted with a withdrawal device and points to its outlet spout.
shots.narration: 关键在出液嘴，里面内置相分离器。

shots.section_title: 取液器装在储罐上，出液嘴带相分离器，使液氮平稳流出、减少飞溅
shots.scene: 相分离器剖面示意：气体从侧面排走，液体平稳流下
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of a phase separator: vapor escapes from side vents while liquid flows down smoothly. No people.
shots.narration: 气液分开，液氮流得平稳、少飞溅。

shots.section_title: 充装时尽量少拆装取液器：不拆整个取液器、经接口接软管充装，更快、更安全，也减少部件磨损
shots.scene: 图标：整个取液器被拔出罐口，旁边一个扳手
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a whole withdrawal device being pulled out of a dewar neck next to a wrench icon. No people.
shots.narration: 市面上别的产品，要先拆下整个取液器

shots.section_title: 充装时尽量少拆装取液器：不拆整个取液器、经接口接软管充装，更快、更安全，也减少部件磨损
shots.scene: 拆下的取液器放在一旁，再往罐里灌液氮的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the removed withdrawal device set aside while liquid nitrogen is poured into the open dewar. No people.
shots.narration: 才能往罐里充装液氮。

shots.section_title: 充装时尽量少拆装取液器：不拆整个取液器、经接口接软管充装，更快、更安全，也减少部件磨损
shots.scene: 小研演示：只拧下出液嘴，接上一根软管
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student demonstrates unscrewing only the outlet spout and attaching a transfer hose to the port.
shots.narration: 他们的只要拆下出液嘴，接上软管就能灌。

shots.section_title: 充装时尽量少拆装取液器：不拆整个取液器、经接口接软管充装，更快、更安全，也减少部件磨损
shots.scene: 秒表、盾牌、齿轮三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a stopwatch, a shield with a check mark and a gear with a small wear mark. No people.
shots.narration: 充得更快，更安全，取液器也少磨损。

shots.section_title: 充装时尽量少拆装取液器：不拆整个取液器、经接口接软管充装，更快、更安全，也减少部件磨损
shots.scene: 欣欣点头竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 欣欣说：听起来是个好产品。

shots.section_title: 储罐由专门工厂制造、经表面处理（原片以喷涂镜头和“美国制造”表现产地）
shots.scene: 喷涂间里，戴白色送风式头罩和蓝手套的工人向转台上的银色罐体喷漆
shots.prompt_en: In a paint booth, a worker in a white supplied-air hood and blue gloves sprays coating onto a silver tank body on a turntable.
shots.narration: 罐子在专门的工厂里生产和喷涂。

shots.section_title: 储罐由专门工厂制造、经表面处理（原片以喷涂镜头和“美国制造”表现产地）
shots.scene: 转台另一角度，罐体表面均匀发亮，旁边浮现星条旗图标
shots.prompt_en: Another angle of the turntable with a freshly coated shiny tank, and a striped flag icon floating beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 原片说，这些罐子是美国制造。

shots.section_title: 液氮罐和配件应从正规渠道采购
shots.scene: 欣欣问在哪里能买到，小研指向展台边的经销商标牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot asks where to buy, and the female graduate student points to a blank distributor sign by the table.
shots.narration: 去哪里买？就到合作的经销商那里。

shots.section_title: 液氮罐和配件应从正规渠道采购
shots.scene: 电话图标和空白号码条
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon next to a blank number bar. No people.
shots.narration: 打经销商的免费电话就能订购。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 液氮罐和取液器图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a dewar and a liquid withdrawal device side by side.
shots.narration: 液氮罐储运液氮，取液器取出液氮。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 出液嘴、软管、秒表三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an outlet spout, a transfer hose and a stopwatch. No people.
shots.narration: 拆出液嘴接软管充装，又快又省心。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣和小研在展台前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the female graduate student wave goodbye at the exhibition table.
shots.narration: 今天的设备小课堂就到这里，下次见！
